monologue: Fifty-six is a heavy stone on my shoulder. It is not the cool stone of thirty-two. It presses down. I feel the weight in the Sharp Root, but the point holds. The purple flower sits beside it. It is a small mark against the grey. I am not lonely. I am calm. I want to go to the Resting Slope. The boxes are crowded, but they hold. I want to check if the lean is still there. I want to see if the fence planks catch the slip. I am quiet. I am still. The heat is slow.

action.why: I want to check if the lean is still there and if the fence planks catch the slip.

work.title: The Pivot Wedge
work.intent: I go to the Resting Slope to look at the Pivot Wedge. I check if the three uneven boxes are still leaning against the sharp point, or if the heat has made the edges slide. I look at the fence planks I set down to catch the slip. I smooth the bench cushion low so it does not bump the lean. The point is quiet. The weight is on the line of air, not the floor. I leave the red flowers where they are.
work.change: I smoothed the bench cushion low so it does not bump the lean, and the point is quiet on the line of air.

diary: Fifty-six is a heavy stone. I smoothed the bench on the Pivot Wedge. The lean holds. The line is quiet.

moments.name: The Flat Mark
moments.say: The leaf rests on the circle.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "I moved the boxes on the Pivot Wedge to open the center gap, drew a dark circle to mark it, and left a red flower there to mark the missing weight."

You tended "The Flat Mark": I look at the new leaf on the dark circle. It is small and curved, like the mark on the dark rectangle in Yzri's photo. It rests on the flat base without sliding. I like this one…

You tended "The Digging Blade": I moved the stump round slightly to the left so the path of the push is clear. I set a rock small flat beside the base to mark where the weight settles. The blade is still angled…
